title: Incident handling and continuity actions need a tested response trace
remediation: The deployment response and continuity leads and component maintainers identify incident classes, required mission continuity actions and approved dynamic response mechanisms. Exercise a benign declared event through detection, analysis, containment, recovery and a continuity decision. Record the authorized roles, measured transitions, tool readiness and follow-up.

milestones.title: Collect an approved response and continuity scenario with dated decisions, recovery checks and observed dynamic response
